findings.description: The proposed projection lists id, name, status, focus, and updated stamp, but does not pin how the producer live-execution count becomes the Work board running count. This leaves room for rendering one supervisor row while the visible running count still stays zero.

Legacy precedence is covered at the pure helper level, but the load-path feature does not explicitly preserve the distinction between an absent supervisors stream and a present empty stream. If the loader normalizes absence to an empty array, static live-agent state can be incorrectly clobbered.

F003 requires a producer-contract-bound drift guard, but the plan does not name the contract artifact or generation mechanism. A copied fixture could satisfy the wording while still failing to detect drift in the real active-supervisor-registry-derived stream shape.

Partial-entry coverage is required, but the proposed features do not define which supervisor fields are required, which are optional, or what fallback values are acceptable for missing focus, timestamps, names, status, or counts.
